name: CEST Adaptive Fullstack Software Pipeline
description: Next-generation adaptive software delivery pipeline: Direct Intake -> Ponytail Architecture -> Ephemeral Strike -> Shift-Left QA & Live Browser Checkpoint

phases.name: Direct Intake, Environment Probe & Preflight Architecture
phases.description: Conductor executes environment probe, interactive intake, confirms feature manifest & skippable phases, ingests AST skeleton with dynamic DI detection, emits CIR contract, and runs preflight contract validation.

phases.name: Ephemeral Parallel Strike Execution
phases.description: Stateless strike workers execute concurrent implementation tasks under strict Ponytail constraints, boundary collision guards, and JIT skill slices.

phases.name: Deterministic Compiler Gate & Adversarial Audit
phases.description: Executes 0-token Pass 1 local compiler gate (tsc/pytest) or diff-audit fallback, followed by Pass 2 adversarial diff inspection for OWASP, Anti-Vibe-Code, and Ponytail compliance.

phases.name: Live Browser Checkpoint & Evolutionary Memory
phases.description: Presents running application to user for live browser review. chief-of-staff distills evolutionary memory from session errors.
